# Modules Database – modules.freyna.org

> All modules of The First Descendant from the official Nexon Open API metadata, values at max Enhancement Level.

Site: https://modules.freyna.org/
Source: https://open.api.nexon.com/static/tfd/meta/en/module.json (verbatim, identical to the NEXON library module view)
All values: max level (every module at its max Enhancement Level; Ancestors modules have no levels). Data synced 01.10.2026 – Nexon has corrected the former x100 Multi-Hit / Additional Attack Chance values.

- Plasma Condensation: Changes the Conductor effect of the passive skill to stackable, The amount of Conductor stacks granted varies by skill, granting additional stacks based on charge time, When reaching Max Stacks, the target takes powerful single-target damage, Lightning Chain now also reacts to Plasma Acceleration Coils (Transcendent · Xantic · Capacity 3 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ines)
- Power Unit Change: Overclock no longer increases Skill Power. Increases Firearm ATK instead. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Lepic / Ultimate Lepic)
- Predator Instinct: While Frenzied, HP is not consumed. Using a firearm while Frenzied gradually increases Firearm ATK. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Gley / Ultimate Gley)
- Proliferating Allergy: Inflicts Explosive Reaction. Deals damage to nearby enemies when the effect ends or the enemy dies. Inflicts the same effect to nearby enemies when the enemy dies. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Yujin / Ultimate Yujin)
- Rampaging Mad Bomber: Cannot buff allies. Increases self-buff effects. (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ultimate Esiemo)
- Regenerative Braking: Chance to recover MP when using skill (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Lepic / Ultimate Lepic)
- Reinforce Front Line: Spawns a Front Line Reinforcement Device that grants a Firearm ATK Up to allies in range. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Enzo)
- Release Cutting Force: Modifies Cutoff Beam so that it can be unleashed as Sword Aura. (Transcendent · Xantic · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Sharen / Ultimate Sharen)
- Restored Heart: Changes Ring of Breach and Gravitic Reversal to skills that grant buffs to allies. (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 3 @ Lv 10 · Only: Nell)
- Safety Training: Changes the Site Intrusion and Designate Danger Zone Skills, Strengthens the Protective Barrier of the Site Intrusion Skill, Changes the Designate Danger Zone Skill to provide a Protective Barrier to nearby allies. (Transcendent · Cerulean · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Harris)
- Self-Directed Eruption: Consumes Magnetic Force every second when used to pull enemies in front of Kyle. Deals great damage to nearby enemies when the skill ends. But removes the ally Shield recovery effect. (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Kyle)
- Septic Torrent: When attacking enemies with a Melee Weapon increases Acidic Infusion Level, When using Hunt, quickly approaches the target and unleashes an AoE attack, When using Septic Torrent, unleashes a continuous damage attack on surrounding targets (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 7 @ Lv 10 · Only: Keelan)
- Shattered Heart: Changes Gaze of the Abyss to an attack skill. Builds up Suspicion stacks using Breach Spikes, then fires enhanced Breach Spikes. (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Nell)
- Shock Punch: Modifies the Charged Sub Attack. Use a Shock Punch to attack when performing a Charged Sub Attack. As the Enhancement Level increases, Max Module Capacity increases (+10). (Normal · Malachite · Capacity 0 @ Lv 10)
- Shortsword: Modifies the Charged Sub Attack. Use a Shortsword to attack when performing a Charged Sub Attack. As the Enhancement Level increases, Max Module Capacity increases (+10). (Normal · Malachite · Capacity 0 @ Lv 10)
- Singer's Mercy: When using skill, sets up a Speaker that grants buffs to allies within range. (Transcendent · Xantic · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Luna / Ultimate Luna)
- Singing Water: Changes so that Laundry stacks. Continuously fires Singing Water forward to deal damage and Additional Damage based on Laundry stacks (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Valby / Ultimate Valby)
- Spiral Tidal Wave: While on water, changes to increase Skill Critical Hit Rate, Creates Spiral Tidal Wave when dealing Skill Critical Hit Damage (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ultimate Valby)
- Superconductive Bombing: While airborne, continuously consumes Magnetic Force to drop bombs. The bombing stops when Magnetic Force is completely depleted, and additional damage from Magnetic Force is not triggered on collision. Airborne duration increases as the Skill Duration increases, but the base airborne duration decreases. (Transcendent · Xantic · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Kyle)
- Superconductive Bombing MARK 2: When used on the ground, takes off and launches Superconductive Bombing in midair. When used in midair, immediately launches Superconductive Bombing MARK 2. (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Kyle)
- Supercooled Kuiper Round: Equipping a Unique Weapon decreases Additional Firearm ATK and Fire Rate, but increases Weak Point Damage and successfully attacking a Weak Point recovers Shield instead of MP. The increase in Weak Point Damage decreases when firing a Unique Weapon, but increases again on a successful Weak Point attack. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 3 @ Lv 10 · Only: Hailey / Ultimate Hailey)
- Super Senses: Inflicts Bleed with Life Siphon. Attacking targets with Bleed with a Unique Weapon, increases damage. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 3 @ Lv 10 · Only: Gley / Ultimate Gley)
- Supply Firearm Enhancer: Summons a Firearm Enhancement Device. Touching the device grants Weak Point Damage and Firearm Critical Hit Rate Up. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Enzo)
- Supply Moisture: While on water, increases Firearm ATK, Firearm Critical Hit Rate, and Firearm Attribute Trigger Rate. When attacking enemies, grants Bubble to self and deals area damage. Does not recover MP. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Valby / Ultimate Valby)
- Tidal Wave: Does not leave a Waterway when moving. When moving through a monster, inflicts skill damage on them. When the skill ends, deals Explosion Damage to nearby enemies. (Transcendent · Cerulean · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Valby / Ultimate Valby)
- Time of the Hunting Hounds: Changes to a skill that quickly Dashes toward enemies. Deals damage and inflicts Conductor on all enemies in the path. Reduces the number of bounces of Chain Lightning and modifies it to be stackable. Modifies the Arche type of the modified skills to Tech. (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ines)
- Tonfa: Modifies the Charged Sub Attack. Use a Tonfa to attack when performing a Charged Sub Attack. As the Enhancement Level increases, Max Module Capacity increases (+10). (Normal · Malachite · Capacity 0 @ Lv 10)
- Toxic Mixture: Modifies the Room 0 Trauma effect to Necrosis. Firearm ATK increases with the number of Necrosis stacks. (Transcendent · Xantic · Capacity 6 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ultimate Freyna)
- Toxic Stimulation: Defense Mechanism skill conversion. Grants Plague Bodyarmor to nearby allies. (Transcendent · Cerulean · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Freyna / Ultimate Freyna)
- Truly Deadly Cuisine: Significantly increases the damage of Giant Fireball. When Giant Fireball explodes, Small Fireballs and Flame Zones do not spawn, If a Flame Zone is present at the Giant Fireball explosion location, applies Cooldown Reduction. (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Blair / Ultimate Blair)
- Turret Engineering: When using skill, recovers the HP of all summoned turrets and extends their duration. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Jayber)
- Venom Injection: When using skill, continuously consumes resources to grant self Toxic Sense. While Toxic Sense is active, hitting an enemy with a firearm or a Skill inflicts Corrosion. (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ultimate Freyna)
- Venom Synthesis: Putrid Venom skill conversion. Leaves behind a Toxic Footprint after every step. Inflicts Room 0 Trauma on enemies coming in contact with Toxic Footprint. (Transcendent · Rutile · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Freyna / Ultimate Freyna)
- Void Charge: Modifies Void Walk to be stackable, and Void Walk and Expulsion damage increases proportionally to DEF. When used as an Enhanced Skill, Cooldown resets. (Transcendent · Almandine · Capacity 5 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ajax / Ultimate Ajax)
- Void Explosion : Focus: Using Expulsion grants Void Explosion that causes an explosion on the next melee attack. When used as an Enhanced Skill, triggers a chain explosion. (Transcendent · Cerulean · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Ajax / Ultimate Ajax)
- Water Play: Creates a rectangular-shaped Puddle of water in front of Valby. (Transcendent · Malachite · Capacity 4 @ Lv 10 · Only: Valby / Ultimate Valby)
